experiment: P5 H4 OOF design and failure-localization audit v1
status: post-OOF diagnostic only; cannot unlock policy, calibration, closed loop, or held-out

split_regimes.resubstitution: fit and evaluate the same rows; optimistic fixed-model capacity diagnostic only
split_regimes.row_random_5fold: SHA256 p5-oof-audit-row-v1 over sample and horizon index modulo 5
split_regimes.sample_disjoint_5fold: SHA256 p5-oof-audit-sample-v1 over sample id modulo 5
split_regimes.label_shuffled_source_5fold: KO only; deterministic opportunity permutation seed 261153 under existing source folds

fixed_models.opportunity: same class-weighted closed-form ridge alpha100 as abstention v1
fixed_models.conditional_ranker: same 81-output ridge alpha100 trained and evaluated only on true positive-opportunity rows; center score zero

diagnostics: opportunity average precision and fold prevalence
conditional ranker signed reward, oracle reward capture, and positive/negative selected schedules
row-random minus source-disjoint and sample-disjoint minus source-disjoint gaps

interpretation_rules.large_row_source_gap: at least 0.02 AP suggests source/domain shift or near-duplicate benefit
interpretation_rules.all_splits_low: row-random AP below 0.05 suggests fixed representation/model cannot identify opportunity even without source generalization
interpretation_rules.conditional_resub_low: less than 25 percent oracle reward capture on positive rows suggests the fixed ranker cannot resolve schedule identity even with training-row reuse
interpretation_rules.negative_control: label-shuffled AP should remain near prevalence

forbidden: calibration, dev, test, held-out, or closed-loop outcomes
using the best split or feature set as confirmatory model selection
changing folds, alpha, hashes, or interpretation thresholds after audit outputs
